sections.Profile:
Blue Max and Red Baron are two related pinball machines produced by Chicago Coin in 1975. Blue Max is the four-player version, while Red Baron is its two-player counterpart. Both games share the same playfield layout but differ in artwork. Designed by Jerry Koci, Albin Peters, and Wendell McAdams with artwork by Loyd Rognan, these machines featured two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, two spinning targets, and two drop targets.
